A day in a field with over 6,000 people with their own master plans was beyond inspirational.

Today I spoke at @ideas_fest to other founders, business owners and entrepreneurs about Influencer Marketing. A panel alongside @astiwagner @tariqpeters_pr @carmenamador and Aditya. A perfect mixture of people and we delivered some brilliant insights for our audience. 

My beautiful friend Kelly, founder of @nixibody came to me us. Kelly and I met at the very beginning and it’s so lovely 6 years in to reflect on the growth of our businesses. Also was wearing Kelly’s thong (she sells knickers and thongs before your mind goes elsewhere on that one 🤣. 

We headed home in time to pick Arthur up from school and I feel totally blessed to be able to have this day and still be back to support him in what is such an important week. 

Thank you for your support everyone. I feel like I am exactly where I am supposed to be 👏
